original.description: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.

assembly.inspection: Scoped ilspycmd inspection only; raw decompiled classes remain private and are not included in this repository.

mechanical_facts.modification: Adds MechanicalPowerTransmission or updates its charge rate; adds gearbox name/description information.
mechanical_facts.default_appearance: MechanicalPowerTransmission does not enable tile effects. IPowerTransmission TileEffects is an uninitialized bool defaulting false; its Render calls SyncTile only when enabled. Installed ordinary gearbox-wall references have exactly the same sprite/mask/palette as BrinestalkWall.
mechanical_facts.boundary: These installed defaults and exported ordinary appearance do not prove all future mod/runtime states. Preserve native changed-tile, powered/broken/spark/overlay behavior rather than inventing a new exposed-gear sprite.

shared_conversion.provenance: Adopt the actual original/reference/manual face/refinement/rejected-cap/corrected16state conversion. No duplicate generation and no new machinery decal.

required_states: All16recipient cardinal connections inherit the same fixed frame, primary/detail roles and material. Machinery/power behavior remains a separate native component, not additional painted parts.
authoring_decision: Use shared converted wall art for the unchanged ordinary native appearance. The word gearbox alone is not a visual-design reference.
native_acceptance: Deferred until all pending conversions are generation-ready; ordinary appearance and changed-state fallback remain final integration checks.
